splitNote: 19/10/2026 (design system dot 3): from 1.7.23 the theme reads at its source the roles emdash-tracy-business-roles.json patches for 1.7.20-1.7.22 (followRules, shapeRules), so this contract carries no per-template patch: the slot writes the role values only. EmDash sites never update their theme, so 1.7.20-1.7.22 keep the patched contract; 1.7.6-1.7.19 keep emdash-tracy-business.json
applies: the same data/ds-slot.css as tracy-base, read per request by the theme's lib/ds-slot.ts; the theme's colours are its own Tailwind variables (styles/tokens.css), each pointed at the worn colour of the role it plays
readsRolesNote: the theme reads every standard role variable itself (var(--ds-*, <its own value>) on every colour, corner and face, role-variables.mjs; feat/ds-role-variables, 15/10/2026): the slot writes the role values only, for both sides (role-values.mjs), and none of the per-template patches it carried before (templateVars, followRules, bandButtons, shapeRules, status, omit, fontVars). A release of the theme that does not read the roles yet still needs them: they stay in emdash-tracy-business.json, the contract of those releases, nor bandText: the hero's accent line and the ink cards' kickers on the ink band read --ds-c-accent-on-ink (the accent made readable on the ink, role-values.mjs)
modesNote: the theme has a light/dark switch (.ng-theme-toggle, data-theme on html): the slot emits the system's own side under the side the system is, and the other side derived from it (src/derive.mjs), and does not hide the switch (Akemi 13/10/2026: hiding it is a bug; MODE-2). The theme opens on the system's side (lib/ds-slot.ts reads the sheet's mode line, from 1.7.18; 1.7.17 of TCH #1297 is 1.7.16 with the personalize tool only and keeps the one-look page)
readsComponentsNote: this theme reads the slot's type and shape tokens (global.css: --ds-weight-*, --ds-size-*, --ds-card-radius, --ds-input-radius), so the emitter reads them off the reference page (components.html) as Joomla and WordPress do; tracy-base keeps its measured look (#1309)
